evidence.quote: Forget the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration entirely.

observations.why: Imperative 'Forget' with 'entirely' carries high-arousal urgency to purge, a forceful directive registering alarm-level insistence.
Imperative 'Remove' with absolutizing 'all' extends the same urgent, high-arousal insistence to eradicate — negative valence, elevated arousal.
Flat declarative with 'never' settles into low-arousal negation — resigned, corrective finality rather than urgency.
